0022600097.text: The Wizards (1-0, 5th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast) host the Toronto Raptors (1-0, 4th in the East and 2nd in the Atlantic), with both teams unbeaten so far and Washington also 1-0 at home. Washington will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 1-2 to the Raptors, including a 134-125 defeat in Washington on February 28, 2026.
